mapper.select: /* spcReg.selSysSpcTree */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "spcNm" ,s.ver AS "ver" ,s.host AS "host" ,s.bas_path AS "basPath" ,d.api_path AS "apiPath" ,d.method_cd AS "methodCd" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF d ON d.API_SPC_NO = s.API_SPC_NO WHERE s.SYS_ID = #{sysId} AND s.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY s.API_SPC_NO, d.SORT_ODRG

/* spcReg.selSpcDetail */ SELECT api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,sys_id AS "sysId" ,aut_id AS "autId" ,api_nm AS "spcNm" ,COALESCE(api_desc, '') AS "spcDesc" ,host AS "host" ,bas_path AS "basPath" ,ver AS "ver" ,COALESCE(api_schema, 'https') AS "schemeCd" ,api_class AS "apiClass" ,COALESCE(api_veri_baseurl, '') AS "testBaseUrl" ,COALESCE(bstgw_yn, 'N') AS "bstgwYn" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC WHERE API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND DEL_YN = 'N'
